blocks.text: Cebu’s football community gained a new place to play on September 12, 2026 as AIA Philippines and SM Prime Holdings opened AIA Stadium beside SM Seaside City Cebu, creating a dedicated space for young players, coaches, families and sports enthusiasts. Launched with the AIA Healthiest Schools Football Clinic alongside the Philippine Football Federation (PFF), Tottenham Hotspur Football Club and local partners, the facility matters because it gives Cebu another space where football, active living and community can grow together. For a city where football has long been part of grassroots and youth development, the new stadium adds something essential to the […]...
